'''Snake''' (Japanese: '''スネーク''' ''Snake'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ096|Crash! Team Dragon Rampage!]]''. He is a [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poacher]] who has an interest in capturing wriggly and serpent-like Pokémon. He is a member of Team Wriggle (Japanese: '''{{j|クネクネ{{ruby|団|だん}}}}''' ''Kunekune-dan'', literally ''Wriggling Gang'').
